            "lineNumber": 8

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          {
            "text": "- **最新コミット**: &#96;486b1c4d9&#96; - consolidate world-writable-directories scanning",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **主要更新**:",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  - execpolicy改善",

          },
          {
            "text": "  - unified exec基本pruning戦略",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 48

          {

            "text": "### 2. upstream/mainをマージ",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
